summary.short: Amends the Swedish Energy Tax Act (1994:1776) from 1 July 2023. It repeals 1 kap. 14 §, 9 kap. 5 a § and 11 kap. 15 §, and gives new wording to rules on state-aid exemptions, electricity tax deductions and refunds, and approval of voluntary taxpayers consuming more than 10 GWh a year.
summary.long: The Act amends the Energy Tax Act. Section 1 kap. 11 a § lists energy and carbon tax exemptions treated as state aid under Article 107(1) TFEU. Section 9 kap. 5 b § sets how electricity and fuels used jointly for heat or cooling are apportioned for refunds. Section 9 kap. 8 § sets minimum refund amounts per calendar quarter and a 2,000 kronor threshold for certain refunds. Section 11 kap. 6 § allows approval as a voluntary taxpayer for persons expected to consume more than 10 GWh of electricity per calendar year in listed uses, with approval revoked if conditions lapse. Section 11 kap. 9 § sets deductions of the difference from the prevailing tax rate minus 0.6 öre per kWh for listed industrial uses and 9.6 öre per kWh for listed municipal uses. Section 11 kap. 16 § requires annual refund applications, allows monthly applications where consumption is at least 150,000 kWh per year, sets a three-year filing limit, and requires electronic filing except for certain refunds. Section 11 kap. 17 § conditions deductions and refunds on the recipient not being a company without a right to state aid and on disclosure of recipient information where amounts exceed 50,000 euro (15,000 euro for certain deductions and refunds). The Act repeals 1 kap. 14 §, 9 kap. 5 a § and 11 kap. 15 §. The new wording of 11 kap. 9 § has no item 7 and the list in 1 kap. 11 a § has no item 10; the text does not state what the removed items covered. Earlier rules continue for periods before entry into force. The text states no penalties.

relations.note: Amends 1 kap. 11 a §, 9 kap. 5 b and 8 §§, and 11 kap. 6, 9, 16 and 17 §§ (new wording). Only these provisions are reproduced in the document.

obligations.summary: When electricity and one or more fuels are used together to produce heat or cooling under 9 kap. 5 §, the energy type must be allocated proportionally when calculating the refund. The taxpayer may choose the allocation between fuels, subject to a rule on electricity from non-taxable sources or sources taxed below the 11 kap. 3 § rate.

obligations.summary: Refund or compensation under 2, 3 and 6 §§ requires a calendar-quarter amount of at least 1 000 SEK (cases under 2 or 6 §) or 500 SEK (cases under 3 §). Refund under 2 § based on 6 a kap. 2 a § may be paid at 500 SEK per calendar year. Refund under 5 § requires the part above 2 000 SEK per quarter, a recipient that is not a company without a right to state aid, and disclosure of recipients.
obligations.conditional_on: Refund or compensation under 2, 3 or 6 §§ is claimed.

obligations.summary: A person may be approved as a voluntary taxpayer if expected to consume more than 10 GWh of electricity per calendar year for the listed uses (rail transport, chemical reduction or electrolytic processes, certain product manufacture, metallurgical or mineral processes, and industrial manufacturing). Approval requires that the applicant is suitable considering its financial circumstances and other conditions.
obligations.conditional_on: Applicant expects to consume more than 10 GWh of electricity per calendar year for an enumerated use.

obligations.summary: Approval as a voluntary taxpayer must be revoked if the conditions for approval no longer exist, or if the voluntary taxpayer requests it. A revocation decision applies immediately unless the decision states otherwise. The text does not name the deciding authority.

obligations.summary: A person liable for electricity tax may deduct electricity tax for listed uses, including rail transport, chemical reduction or electrolytic processes, product manufacture under 6 a kap. 1 § 6, grid transmission for network function, metallurgical or mineral processes, and industrial manufacturing. Deduction under item 6 is the difference between the applicable tax rate and 0.6 öre per kWh; under item 8 it is 9.6 öre per kWh.
obligations.conditional_on: Use falls within one of the listed purposes and the deduction conditions in 11 kap. 17 § are met.

obligations.summary: An application for refund of electricity tax under 12–14 §§ covers one calendar year, unless the tax authority permits monthly applications. The application must be submitted electronically, except for refunds under 12 b §. It must be submitted to the tax authority within three years after the end of the calendar year or month, and signed by the applicant or an authorised representative. An application by a legal person is deemed made by the applicant unless the signer clearly lacked authority.
obligations.conditional_on: Refund of electricity tax under 12–14 §§ is claimed.

obligations.summary: Deduction or refund under 9 § first paragraph 6, 7 or 8, or under 10, 12, 12 a, 12 b or 14 §, is allowed only if the recipient is not a company without a right to state aid, and the taxpayer or applicant provides information on recipients and the distribution of aid among them. For recipients whose combined reduction under the scheme exceeds 50 000 euro per calendar year, these requirements apply; for deduction under 10 § and refund under 12 or 12 a §, the threshold is 15 000 euro per calendar year.
obligations.conditional_on: Deduction or refund is claimed under the listed provisions.

enforcement.note: This amending act contains no fine, criminal penalty, clawback, suspension or blocking provision. The only revocation rule, 11 kap. 6 § (approval as voluntary taxpayer must be revoked when its conditions lapse or the taxpayer requests it), is a status rule rather than a sanction for breach and is not coded here. Refund and deduction conditions in 8, 16 and 17 §§ are eligibility conditions, not sanctions.
